policy_notes.note: HUD 2026 Budget Management Letter: vouchers are funding-constrained. PHAs asked to stop issuing new vouchers (except HUD-VASH and FYI), pause new project-based voucher commitments, and cut payment standards, ending exception payment standards and staying inside the 90-110% basic range. Expect payment standards toward the low end of the range.
NSPIRE inspections for vouchers delayed to 2027-02-01 (third extension). Until then PHAs may still inspect under the old HQS (24 CFR 982.401). The checklist here aims at both.

Emergency Housing Vouchers are ending: families under EHV HAP contracts on 2026-09-30 move to Tenant Protection Vouchers by 2026-12-31 (PIH 2026-25); closeout from early 2027. For a landlord the lease continues as an ordinary voucher.
PHAs may use HCV admin fees for landlord signing/retention bonuses, security and utility deposits and holding fees (PIH 2022-18). Optional and per PHA; 2026 budget pressure makes them scarcer.
